plugin_desc: SNMP child template for Teleste access and headend platforms (Luminato and other devices implementing the Teleste common element MIB, enterprise PEN 3715). Beyond the shared Access SNMP floor for uptime and IF-MIB 64-bit interface traffic, it collects per-module internal temperature and the element-wide fan status. The common MIB defines no private CPU, memory or power-supply objects, so they are not collected.
name: Access

metrics.name: device_temperature_celsius
metrics.description: Internal temperature of each Teleste module from TELESTE-COMMON-MIB statusInternalTemperature, reported in 0.1 degC and divided by 10 at collection. Rows reporting 0 (temperature not available) are dropped.

metrics.name: device_fan_state
metrics.description: Common fan status of the Teleste element from TELESTE-COMMON-MIB statusFan (fanNormal(1) = all fans normal, fanFailure(2) = at least one fan failed), normalized so that 1 = healthy and 2 = fault.

metrics.name: interface_ifHCInOctets
metrics.description: This metric indicates the average rate of bytes received over the past 5 minutes, based on the 64-bit ifHCInOctets counter which does not wrap on high-speed interfaces.

metrics.name: interface_ifHCOutOctets
metrics.description: This metric indicates the average rate of bytes sent over the past 5 minutes, based on the 64-bit ifHCOutOctets counter which does not wrap on high-speed interfaces.

metrics.name: snmp_uptime
metrics.description: This metric indicates the uptime of the device since the last restart. By monitoring the uptime, network administrators can understand the stability and reliability of the device and identify potential reboot or failure issues.
